title: DesiredStateMsg
description: Topic dev/{mid}/{did}/state/desired, cloud to device, QoS 1, retained. The complete desired state; apply it when version is higher than the last applied one, then report state with ack_version = version. This is the only command path.

factory_reset.description: Reserved: erase user data and Wi-Fi credentials, report a 'reset' event on channel 'device', reboot unclaimed.

join_mode.description: Reserved, gateways only: accept new sub-devices for this many seconds; sent together with join_token.

join_token.description: Reserved, gateways only: claim token to put into the claim message of every sub-device that joins during join_mode.

ttl_s.description: Informational: the cloud clears this retained command after ttl_s seconds.
